title: Does anyone's Mallworld have an endless jungle gym in the center?
content: I've been dreaming of Mallworld for as long as I can remember, but in my version there is a giant jungle gym in the center of the mall. It has slides and ball pits, sometimes there's water slides on the outside. I'm always with other people, but I don't seem to actually interact with anyone, we're all just kind of doing our own thing. There's also a version of this when I'm dreaming of the water park city, but it's outdoors in a bright sort of artificial environment. Anyway, I was bored and asked AI to render a picture of Mallworld, and this is what it came up with. It's basically spot on, although my dream version is way larger and more complex. Just thought I'd share.
